title: Police Officers Waste No Time Saving Residents From Burning Apartment
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On November 29, 2020, an early morning fire destroyed two buildings and severely damaged many surrounding businesses. Three police officers were first to respond and were able to get a resident out before it was fully engulfed in flames. The cause of the fire was ruled undetermined. Fire investigators interviewed the resident of the apartment unit where the fire had allegedly begun. The resident believed it could’ve originated from a faulty baseboard heater that his landlord neglected. It's unknown if any of the pets were saved or lost. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
